runtime.host: zcode headless CLI via the ZCode.app bundle
runtime.mode: headless print mode (-p), disposable scratch Git project, project-scope hooks

steps.prompt: Reply with the single word DONE

steps.method: four marker command hooks (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, Stop) registered project-scope in the same scratch config; one completed headless session
steps.finding: zcode 0.16.5 -p executes no project-scope hooks at all

disclosures: Headless -p hook execution is a verified negative: no adapter handler can run in this mode, so the empty session state is fully explained by the probe finding and not by payload shape.

An earlier run in this series produced model replies that referenced Super Caveman stop phrasing; those replies come from the skill listing visible to the model, not from hook injection, and an interim camelCase-payload attribution was corrected on the record.
Live firing in the interactive GUI host was not verified in this attempt (host automation was blocked by an accessibility permission), so GUI live firing stays unclaimed.
The 2026-09-02 hook-surface receipt this work depended on was found committed empty; the surface was re-derived and recorded as evidence/zcode-hook-surface-2026-09-04.md.
